|game_text=Permanent pilot provides ability of 4. May add 1 astromech. During battle, may target a starship with no character piloting. Draw destiny. If destiny > defense value, target hit. Immune to attrition < 3.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E3 of [[Bravo Fighter (V) (Virtual Block 5)]] (version 4 of 4); it is the current text. The image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1250-80-front-master.png]]), which prints this text. Versions in date order: [[Bravo Fighter (V) (Virtual Block 5)]] (original, release sheet of 7 December 2009); [[Bravo Fighter (V) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[Bravo Fighter (V) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as the original); '''this page''' (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' ([[Bravo Fighter (V) (Virtual Block 5)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 5 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Permanent pilot provides ability of 4. May add 1 astromech. During battle, may target a starship with no character piloting. Draw destiny. If destiny > defense value, target hit. Immune to attrition < 3.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=9 Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 9, slip 81. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf#page=9 Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again. Under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 (this page), and the current text.<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=49, page 49. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=49 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints the slip number “81” at the bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Bravo Fighter (V) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) changed “May add 1 astromech” to “May add one astromech” and moved “Permanent pilot provides ability of 4.” from the front to just before “Immune to attrition < 3.”. PC-E1 text: “May add one astromech. During battle, may target a starship with no character piloting. Draw destiny. If destiny > defense value, target hit. Permanent pilot provides ability of 4. Immune to attrition < 3.”<ref name="cl-1250_80-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Bravo Fighter (V) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-L-bravofighter-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[Bravo Fighter (V) (Virtual Block 5)]]) again, word for word: “Permanent pilot provides ability of 4. May add 1 astromech. During battle, may target a starship with no character piloting. Draw destiny. If destiny > defense value, target hit. Immune to attrition < 3.” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual5-Light card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual5-Light">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034659/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual5-Light/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual5-Light/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints the slip number “81” at the bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 49)<ref name="ml-ls" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[Bravo Fighter (V) (Virtual Block 5)]]) again, word for word: “Permanent pilot provides ability of 4. May add 1 astromech. During battle, may target a starship with no character piloting. Draw destiny. If destiny > defense value, target hit. Immune to attrition < 3.” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1250-80-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number (the release-sheet slip and the PC card image print “81”).
